title: Deadline
description: My latest game project, built in Unreal Engine — with a hand-drawn official poster featuring a very familiar black cat.
descriptionAr: أحدث مشاريعي في تطوير الألعاب، مبني باستخدام Unreal Engine — مع ملصق رسمي مرسوم يدوياً تظهر فيه قطة سوداء مألوفة جداً.
overview: Deadline is my latest game project, developed in Unreal Engine.
overviewAr: Deadline هو أحدث مشاريعي في تطوير الألعاب، طُوّر باستخدام Unreal Engine.

sections.body: Deadline is my latest game project, developed in Unreal Engine.

sections.title: Official Poster
sections.body: The official poster is a hand-drawn illustration featuring the Tuwaiq Academy building, a black cat and red Deadline lettering.
sections.bodyAr: الملصق الرسمي رسم يدوي يظهر فيه مبنى أكاديمية طويق، وقطة سوداء، وكلمة Deadline بخط أحمر.

images.alt: Official Deadline poster: a hand-drawn illustration of the Tuwaiq Academy building with a black cat and red Deadline lettering.
images.altAr: الملصق الرسمي للعبة Deadline: رسم يدوي لمبنى أكاديمية طويق مع قطة سوداء وكلمة Deadline باللون الأحمر.
images.caption: Official poster

editorNotes: Poster: place DeadlinePoster(1).pdf (or DeadlinePoster.pdf) in media-source/incoming/ and run `npm run media` — it renders a web copy and keeps the PDF.
The YouTube video could not be inspected while building, so no gameplay details were written. Add concept, mechanics, role and team info once confirmed.
Do not describe the game as solo work unless confirmed.
